name: postgres_database_query
description: Run one read-only PostgreSQL query against the podcast database and get JSON rows back (at most 200 rows / 40,000 characters; longer output is cut off). Tables: podcasts(id, name, description); episodes(id, podcast_id, title, description, published_at, guests, source_url, transcript_text); passages(id, episode_id, ordinal, text, embedding) - never select embedding; claims(id, passage_id, text, evidence_quote, speaker, specificity, materiality, source_standing, signal) - the last four are 0-100 scores from the ranking step (NULL if not ranked yet); signal is the overall investment-signal score, so ORDER BY signal DESC NULLS LAST to see the strongest claims first; entities(id, name, kind: company|person|technology|concept); claim_entities(claim_id, entity_id); theses(id, description, is_active, created_at); thesis_entities(thesis_id, entity_id); ingestion_jobs(id, episode_id, status, current_step, error); watch_sources(id, url, description, is_active, last_checked_at, ingest_since) - the podcast feeds being watched. IDs are UUIDs shared with the knowledge graph.
